headline: KB Kookmin and Hana Bank also hit as Korea bank hacking concerns grow
body: KB Kookmin Bank said Friday that information on 119 customers leaked after abnormal external access to a mobile system used by employees, and Hana Bank said information on 89 customers was exposed after a hacking agent's attempt to access its sales support system, a day after a breach at Shinhan Bank affecting about 25,000 customers. The Financial Services Commission and Financial Supervisory Service dispatched investigators to the banks and shared the intrusion methods with other agencies.
note: The Korea Times reports a Chinese-language AI penetration-testing tool, possibly linked to an open-source system called ARTEX AI, was found on a server tied to the Shinhan attack, an early sign of AI agents probing bank systems. That argues for routine AI-powered testing of every system a bank runs.

evidence.text: On Friday, KB Kookmin Bank said that personal information belonging to 119 customers was leaked after abnormal external access to a mobile system used by employees.
Later that day, Hana Bank said personal information belonging to 89 customers had been exposed following an external hacking agent's attempt to gain unauthorized access to its sales support system.
Those incidents came a day after Shinhan Bank disclosed a data breach affecting about 25,000 customers.
Shinhan said an unauthorized party bypassed authentication to access a service used by loan agents to check the status of applications.

The Financial Services Commission said it and the Financial Supervisory Service dispatched investigators to the affected firms and shared the IP addresses and intrusion methods with relevant agencies.
According to local media reports, traces of a Chinese-language AI penetration-testing tool were found on a server believed to have been used in the attack against the bank.

The server's HTML title reportedly contained a Chinese phrase meaning “AI autonomous penetration testing console,” suggesting a possible link to ARTEX AI, an open-source autonomous penetration-testing system built on a large language model.
Shinhan, Kookmin, Hana data breaches fuel concerns over AI-powered cyberattacks in financial sector
